facts.fact: 1943年9–11月Drancy地道密谋：演员Robert Manuel等从犹太指挥官办公室下地下室挖118英尺到Avenue Jean Jaurès防空洞；三班倒每班20人全天挖；oxylyth制氧；土藏入地窖踩实。
facts.anchor: Burrow out of the camp by digging a tunnel in a basement below the Jewish commander’s office. About 118 feet separated the spot from a small air raid shelter on Avenue Jean Jaurès, the city’s main street.

facts.fact: Manuel白天给孩子们背拉封丹《橡树与芦苇》寓言（"我弯折但不折断"）；德国守卫从后面看、骂他"大嘴巴"；幸好听不懂——这正是密谋者的哲学。
facts.anchor: Fortunately, Manuel wrote later, they didn’t understand the words. “Je plie, et ne romps pas.” I bend, and do not break.

facts.fact: 地道距离成功仅10英尺时告密；Brunner从Nice赶回、酷刑逼供出14人名单；14人被靠墙排、枪指头、发烟；Brunner讽刺"你们干得好"后没开枪（还要更多名字）。
facts.anchor: “You’ve done a good job,” Brunner said. “We didn’t think Jews were capable of building a tunnel.”

facts.fact: 报复：65名营内犹太人"职务"人员（楼梯长/医生/护士/首领Blum）被送上1943年11月20日Convoy 62；Léon与Bertrand、Fanny在内，称"地道驱逐"；Béatrice被留下"不知怎的仍被保护"。
facts.anchor: Sixty-five Jewish prisoners who were part of the prison’s envied camp administration—staircase chiefs, doctors, nurses, the camp’s security chief and director, Robert Blum—were forced aboard the next convoy on November 20, 1943.

facts.fact: 上车时Bertrand（Irène唯一孙子）拒绝登车，抱住每根管道栏杆，被德国人在亲人面前毒打；一些密谋者唱马赛曲"La France aux Français"；车厢6有19人从破窗跳车逃生。
facts.anchor: It was a scene I’ll never forget; Bertrand, refusing up to the last moment to leave Drancy, clung to every pipe and rail, savagely beaten by the Germans, in front of his loved ones, so as not to be taken away.

facts.fact: 1943年11月23日凌晨Convoy 62到Auschwitz；>1,200人挨鞭选命：241男45女挑去做苦工，其余近900人（含150儿童）被Zyklon B杀害；空气里有"甜而明确的烧灼气味"。
facts.anchor: One line was sent to death, the other to labor. Smoke hung over the camp, drifting into the night. The air carried a thick, sweet, unmistakable smell—burning.

facts.fact: Léon/Bertrand/Fanny因"地狱彩票"幸存；Bertrand被刺青号码164608；"身份只剩算术，身体缩减为代码——曾被社交版书写、被法国部长颂扬的家庭，现在只是数字：消失前的最后一道铭文"。
facts.anchor: From that moment, identity existed only as arithmetic, the body reduced to a code. The family once written about in society columns and celebrated by French ministers now existed as numbers—the last inscription before disappearance.
